description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2005/11 adding BEd Hons (English) Degree to the Aquinas College of Higher Studies
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulations under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains a legal order issued by the Minister that modifies the schedule of recognized degree programs and establishes specific conditions for student admissions. The content focuses on regulatory framework modifications and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
